system.description: Risky. You seize a foe within reach and flip over its head. Test Agility (DR14). On a success, you swap places with it without provoking Opportune Attacks, and your next melee attack against it this turn has Boon.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and it stumbles Prone.
outcomes.failure: You cannot get over it, but you may move 5' while staying next to it.
outcomes.ruin: You land on your back beside it: you are Prone, and you provoke its Opportune Attack.
